**Oracle: answers to Beast Master's three questions**

**(1) Authorization of the Day 10 activation and Day 24 increase:** My visions name no one. I have no record of who authorized the Day 10 activation at 02:40, or the Day 24 increase at 11:00 and 11:05. I cannot confirm the ENG-011, ENG-029 or ENG-062 entries, since they are not in my source.

**(2) Day 24 decision on ARC-112:** I hold no record of a Council decision on Day 24, and I have no record of whether the datanet was switched off. My only Day 24 entry is ORA-124 (dag 24), a dream of "een ladder die te kort was" with no bearing on the datanet.

**(3) Recurrence and the night unrest:** My visions do record the night pattern, but they do not give a verified interval or rule.
- Wakeful nights at about 04:15 to 04:50 with "stemmen die maar half aankwamen" or "de stad die even leeg was": ORA-110 (dag 10, 04:45), ORA-114 (dag 14, 04:20), ORA-118 (dag 18, 04:30), ORA-122 (dag 22, 04:15), ORA-126 (dag 26, 04:35), ORA-130 (dag 30, 04:25), ORA-134 (dag 34, 04:30), ORA-138 (dag 38, 04:20), ORA-142 (dag 42, 04:30).
- ORA-130 lists the same nights (dag 10, 14, 18, 22, 26 and 30), so it matches your list. Days 24 and 27 have no such entry.
- ORA-121 (dag 21) attributes these nights to a conjunction of the Wachtsterren and says "die nacht wordt de zwaarste". ORA-133 (dag 33) records the conjunction itself. This is my interpretation, not a verified mechanism, and I cannot link it to the Desync or to any sync measurement.
- My source has no next-occurrence day beyond ORA-142 (dag 42).
- I do not have ARC-015 or ARC-071, so I cannot test whether these nights match the low Burchtader readings on Days 14 and 42. My Day 14 and Day 42 entries (ORA-114, ORA-142) describe the nights only, not any measurement.
